caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher with a curved handle, placed within a rectangular frame on a beige-toned paper background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of gray and features elaborate floral decorations and a monogrammed oval medallion with the letters "SC" on its side. The body of the pitcher has an elegant, elongated shape with a flared spout and a round base set upon a hexagonal platform. The handle arches gracefully from the top of the pitcher to the upper body. In the lower left corner of the main frame, there is a small, simplified outline sketch of the pitcher’s silhouette, also within a rectangular box. The artist’s signature, "V. Carano," is located in the bottom right corner outside the frame. The overall composition centers the pitcher, with the smaller sketch providing an additional, minimal view of the object. The artwork utilizes subtle shading and fine lines to highlight the contours and decorative elements of the pitcher.
title: Silver Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
